baseline_reuse: Direct, DBN, and PLPDP whole-track metrics are reused from the mechanism bundle because they do not depend on CASM duration_sigma; every displayed event trace was decoded again.
intended_use: mechanism visualization only; not aggregate performance evidence

selection_policy.ambiguous: non-fallback; exact CASM/Direct event equality in the window; mean and median period margin <= 0.16; CASM F1 >= 0.35; no more than 0.01 below either DBN or PLPDP
selection_policy.clear: non-fallback; at least six references; window CASM F1 >= 0.55 and >= 0.025 above Direct, DBN default, DBN 30-300, and PLPDP
